company_type: Aditya Birla group, India's largest cement producer + GCCA founding member

technology.technology_name: Blended Cement + Specialty Concrete Portfolio (Litecon, Hypercon, Pervious, DuraPlus)
technology.description: UltraTech produces blended cement using fly ash, GGBS (ground granulated blast furnace slag), and other supplementary cementitious materials to partly substitute clinker, plus a specialty concrete portfolio at IGBC-GreenPro-certified RMC plants (Medchal/Hyderabad, Pawane/Navi Mumbai, Wagholi/Pune). 73 UltraTech products have received GreenPro certification.
technology.problem_solved: Reduces clinker factor (and embodied CO2) in cement while utilising industrial waste (fly ash, slag). Specialty concretes (lightweight, pervious, high-flow) address modern construction needs.
technology.innovation_summary: GCCA founding member; committed to GCCA net-zero concrete roadmap 2050; integrated alternative fuels + raw materials + waste heat recovery + renewable energy in cement process.
technology.unique_selling_points: Largest scale (India + GCC); circular economy positioning; 73 GreenPro products; carbon capture pilot programme
technology.application_area: All categories of construction: residential, commercial, infrastructure (roads, bridges), industrial
technology.target_industries: Real estate developers, infrastructure contractors (L&T, Tata Projects), state PWDs, NHAI
technology.patent_status: Numerous filings around blended cement formulations and process improvements
technology.patent_jurisdiction: IN primary; selected PCT for carbon capture integration
technology.estimated_market_size: Indian cement market ~₹4,00,000 Cr by 2027; blended cement growing 8–10% CAGR
technology.preferred_license_type: Quick License (incremental tech inflow); Patent Buyout (carbon-capture-cement) outbound
technology.certification_status: IGBC GreenPro (73 products); BIS (IS 269, IS 8112, IS 12269, IS 455 for slag cement, IS 3812 for fly ash); ECBC compatibility; GRIHA-eligible
